verdict.rationale: Medusa's evidence suggests users control their own data, but none of it explicitly covers retention or deletion. The pricing page lists "Data sovereignty, SOC2, custom DPA" and BYOC with an Enterprise License. The core modules are open-source, so a self-hosting deployment owns its own data stores. Missing for 10: documented retention-policy configuration, documented data/PII deletion or erasure workflows (e.g., customer data deletion APIs), retention terms for Medusa Cloud backups, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
